title: Tokenizer compatibility shim for legacy role encodings during model pin transitions
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Objective: implement a short-lived compatibility shim in the tokenization/onboarding pipeline to handle legacy role encodings and delimiter heuristics when pinning models and publishing performance profiles. Background: older model bundles (v1.x) from community sources sometimes rely on implicit role markers encoded as printable delimiters or tokenized escape sequences. New onboarding flow expects structured role objects and canonical chat templates. When customers pin to older variants we see mismatches in token counts, prefix caching, and prompt framing that affect latency, cost, and quality. Scope: detect legacy role patterns at bundle onboarding; apply deterministic normalization before profile sampling (server-side only); provide runtime toggle to enable shim during rollout; add telemetry for mismatch rate and per-model token delta; add unit and integration tests; do a staged rollout and revert path.
acceptance_criteria: Shim detects >95% of common legacy role encodings (examples captured in doc)
On pinned model bundles, token delta between pre- and post-normalization < 2% for canonical prompts
No regression in existing runtime SLOs (latency P95 within 10% of baseline)
Telemetry dashboard shows mismatches and successful normalizations per bundle
Automated tests cover boundary cases: zero-width markers, doubled delimiters, and escaped role tokens
comments: 2025-01-21 Aisha B: Spike complete — enumerated 27 corpus-level legacy encodings from model bundles used in recent onboards (samples attached in Confluence). Observed three classes: explicit printable delimiters (e.g. 'User:'), concatenated role tokens (e.g. 'User<|role|>:'), and invisible control markers (zero-width joiner sequences).

2025-01-27 Marco L: Proposed implementation: lightweight detection pass in onboarding that emits a normalized 'role_marker' token and a flag 'legacy_role_normalized'. Normalization rules are deterministic and reversible for audit. Pushed prototype branch with tokenizer adapter and tests (PR linked).

2025-01-30 Priya Nair (review): Good approach. Please add a feature flag guarded runtime path and ensure bundler produces a manifest field 'legacy_role_policy' to make rollbacks deterministic. Also request perf microbench for prefix caching behavior.

2025-02-03 Ethan Cole (perf): Microbench shows 6% token increase for one bundle before normalization due to double-escaped markers — normalization drops it to baseline. Need to check KV-cache hit behavior for very short prefixes.

2025-02-07 Marco L: Implemented runtime toggle and manifest field. Added telemetry counters: legacy_role_detected, legacy_role_normalized, normalization_failure. Enabled staged rollout on internal dedicated environment (cluster-qa).

2025-02-10 Aisha B: QA smoke passed on cluster-qa for first 10 pinned bundles. Preparing rollout playbook and customer communication template in case we see subtle output diffs. Next: enable on 10% of hosted traffic for flagged bundles and monitor dashboards for quality regressions.
